extracted.stage: Financial remedy proceedings, next hearing listed
extracted.summary: A solicitor at Fairweather Legal LLP enquires about a £44,000 litigation loan for a divorce applicant in financial remedy proceedings with roughly £574,500 of assets in dispute and a hearing at Bristol Family Court on 21 September 2026.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for your client's financial remedy proceedings. We have noted the £44,000 sought, the assets in dispute of around £574,500 and the hearing listed at Bristol Family Court on 21 September. To take this further we would need your client's details and confirmation of their position in the proceedings, a breakdown of the costs to be funded, details and evidence of the assets in dispute (including any existing charges or competing claims), and confirmation of your firm's engagement. We will send our criteria and application form and come back to you once we have reviewed the information. Nothing in this email constitutes an offer of finance or an indication of terms.
